name: web-app-users-sitting-against-giant-phone-social-icons-flat-illustration
title: Two flat-illustrated people sitting against a giant phone surrounded by colourful floating social and app icons
whatItIs: A flat vector illustration of a man and woman sitting back-to-back against a giant smartphone showing an app grid, surrounded by a scattered cloud of colourful icon tiles (chat, camera, heart, gear, mail, share) on a transparent chequered background.
whatItMeans: Busy and energetic; a dense cloud of icons around a calm seated pose suggests an app that connects to everything at once.
techniques: Surround a calm central scene with a dense cloud of small icons.
Scale a device to giant size so figures can lean against it.
Vary icon colours widely for a lively, connected feel.

vocabulary.definition: A loose scattered cluster of many small icons.
An illustration with no background, ready to overlay anywhere.
